verdict.rationale: Jan documents importing existing GGUF files from local disk instead of downloading them again (jan-docs-10). Its server runs on llama.cpp (jan-docs-6), which suggests a standard, portable model format. That covers only one direction of reuse: nothing says where Jan stores its downloads or whether other runtimes can read them without converting them. Missing for 10: documented model storage location and layout, explicit statement that Jan-downloaded files and caches are standard and usable by other runtimes, guidance on sharing a model directory with tools like Ollama or LM Studio, and independent hands-on corroboration.
